# v1.3.1 — Themed milestone badges & Library/History crash fix

## What changed

- **Milestone badges got a lot harder.** The lifetime ladder now starts at
  **100 chapters** and climbs steeply: **100, 500, 1250, 2500, 5000 and
  10000**. The early easy tiers are gone, so a badge actually means something.
- **Every badge has its own icon.** No more generic checkmarks. Each tier now
  shows a distinct icon, and **each naming theme has its own icon set** — Murim
  shows swords and flames, Mage shows wands and stars, Hunter shows eyes and
  lightning, and so on.
- **A colour ramp for the tiers.** Badges climb through **bronze, silver, gold,
  platinum, diamond and mythic** colours, so your progress is readable at a
  glance. Locked badges stay dimmed until you earn them.

## Fixes

- **Fixed a crash in the Library.** Opening the Library could throw
  `librarylastdata is not defined` and leave the page blank. The library's
  filter, sort, offline-status and multi-select state are now properly declared.
- **Fixed a crash in History.** The history search box threw
  `historysearchterm is not defined`. History search now works again.

## Under the hood

- The milestone module exposes a `TIER_RAMP`, a per-theme `THEME_ICONS` map and
  an `iconSvg()` helper that emits inline SVG (icons inherit the badge colour
  via `currentColor`).
- Milestone and account tests updated for the new thresholds, tiers and icons.
